# Event lines ("event/<id>", one per built event) have three owners that rewrite only their own lines:
# ls_sim::events::replays (B1 and any later built event), ls_sim::events::visitor_replays (B2's visitors)
# and ls_sim::event_replays (B3's spectacles). Mode lines: ls_sim::modes::the_architect::replay and
# ls_sim::modes::belt_up::replay. Re-bless with LS_BLESS_MOOD_REPLAYS=1, one cargo run per harness (some
# read this file at compile time): cargo test -p ls-sim --lib <filter> with the filters world_replays::,
